title: Rapid and facile colorimetric biosensing of dengue NS1 antigen using gold nanoparticles: potential for point-of-care testing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17295-17304
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10028C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Annisa Indah Reza, Fitri Fadila, Dita Cinta Toharani, Dita Ariyanti, Agustina Vidiawati, Nagatoshi Nishiwaki, Agustina Sus Andreani
Herein, we report the detection of dengue virus (DF) using a modified AuNPs colorimetric biosensor, providing a fast, accurate, and user-friendly solution suitable for point-of-care testing.
